name: resend-1.0.0
description: Email delivery via Resend API — for digests, non-urgent notifications, and HTML-formatted reports

tools.name: email_send
tools.description: Send an HTML email to Zeus (or a custom address) via Resend. Use for digests, non-urgent summaries, reports, and any content better suited to email than chat.

subject.description: Email subject line. Priority prefix ([CRITICAL], [HIGH]) is added automatically based on the priority field.

body.description: Email body text. Rendered as a paragraph in the HTML template.

to.description: Recipient email address. Defaults to ZEUS_EMAIL env var.

priority.description: Priority level — affects subject prefix. Default: normal.

action_url.description: Optional URL for a CTA button rendered in the email body.
